reconstruction_summary: Re-ran the agent's favourite V4 model: V3 single-track with fitted Caf/Car (from out/ladder.json) + per-segment straight-line bias removal + LOSO Ridge residual learner (alpha=1) on [v, |a_y|, |delta|, sign(ddelta/dt)] across all canonical Ford segments.
notes: V4 = (ST with agent's fitted Caf=158261, Car=138285 N/rad on Mach-E) + per-canonical-segment straight-line (|delta|<0.01) bias removal + LOSO Ridge(alpha=1) residual learner on features [v, |a_y_meas|, |delta|, sign(d delta/dt)]. ST physical params (L, m, l_f, l_r) are Mach-E values used for both Ford platforms — agent's coefficients are Mach-E-specific so pooling across F-150 Lightning loses fidelity. LOSO solved in closed form via leave-one-group-out sufficient-statistics on (X^TX, X^Ty), matching sklearn Ridge(alpha=1.0, fit_intercept=True) up to numerical precision. baseline_rmse_recomputed matches canonical to 3.47e-18.
